chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a Muslim man whom illness or a matter in which Allah excuses him prevented from performing Hajj. So he said: 'Upon him is that he should send a Sarurah (a poor man who has not performed Hajj) from his wealth to perform Hajj on his behalf, who has no wealth for himself.'

key_terms.صَرُورَةً: A poor person who has not performed Hajj, sent to perform it on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a Muslim who cannot perform Hajj due to illness?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'Hajj al-Badal' (substitute Hajj), where a wealthy individual unable to travel due to valid excuses like illness must appoint a poor person to perform Hajj on their behalf. The term 'Sarurah' specifically denotes a destitute person who has not yet fulfilled the obligation, highlighting the Shia emphasis on utilizing the wealth of the able-bodied to assist the spiritually or physically incapacitated. This ruling underscores the communal responsibility in maintaining the pillars of Islam even when individual capacity is limited.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘I asked himasws about a Muslim man prevented by illness between him and the Hajj, or a matter in which Allahazwj has Excused him. So he said, ‘Upon him is that he should get a Saroura man (who has not performed Hajj) who has no wealth for himself, to perform Hajj on his behalf from his wealth’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id form al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “

I once asked him (the Imam), Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a Muslim who is prevented from performing al-Hajj because of illness or some other good reason in the sight of Allah. He (the Imam) said, ‘He is required that someone else who has not performed al-Hajj and does not have any assets, go to al-Hajj on his behalf on his expenses.’”
